lesson.title: Pin interpreters by absolute path in gates, hooks and scheduled tasks
lesson.source: stabilization cycle 2026-08-25-0200: interpreters mutated live mid-session by a concurrent provisioning lane; lesson was queued as 'mint L035' but silently lost to ID-slot collision - reminted 2026-08-26
lesson.lesson: Automation surfaces - pre-commit hooks, gates, scheduled tasks, CI steps - must resolve their interpreter by absolute path or a sys.executable-derived fallback, never a bare PATH lookup: provisioning lanes mutate PATH and install or remove interpreters while sessions run, so 'python' can silently switch between Store stub and real build between two invocations. When interpreter resolution fails in automation, fail loud naming the resolved path so the next session sees which interpreter was expected.
